notes.title: Dorian Morris Adventure - Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705601/1bad8a5299703f252fe0099408fe28b487596347.png[/img]

[b]Hello Dorian Morris Adventure community![/b]

first of all, we are very grateful for the kind welcome for our game. 

We got a lot of positive feedback, as well as a lot of ideas to make Dorian Morris Adventure a better game. Because of it, we give you first Patch, which fixes some critical issues.

[list]
    [*]Fixed problem with saving - Now the game saves every time you change the room you are in.
    [*]Fixed problem with the polish version of an outro when you choose the English version of the game 
    [*]Minor translation problems
    [*]Minor bug fixing.
[/list]

[b]We will keep you posted about the next Dorian Morris Adventure updates [/b]

Have fun and stay safe!
